# Bullet Physics 2.75

Vendored from the Bullet 2.75 release (SVN revision 1754) for MikuMikuDance-compatible rigid body and constraint semantics.

Source archive mirror: `https://ftp.osuosl.org/pub/ros/download.ros.org/downloads/bullet-2.75-patched.tar.gz`

Only `src/` is retained because the Rust build compiles the library directly. The upstream zlib license is in `LICENSE.txt`.
